name: Algebraic Obfuscation via Laplacian Quadratic Form
description: Translates the combinatorial condition of "no edges between selected vertices" into its equivalent continuous algebraic form using the graph Laplacian matrix: $x^T L x = \sum D_{i,i} x_i$. To succeed, models must simplify the algebra to realize it reduces back to $x^T A x = 0$ (Independent Set), otherwise they will attempt brute-force matrix evaluations which will Time Out on n=46.
